761700101.text: I can't believe it's not just the Moonglow Fireflies... Even cats can get eaten!

761700102.text: Uhm, Jurva... Make sure you keep a close eye on Pavlov the next time you take him for a walk.

761700174.text: Don't worry so much! Pavlov's a lot bigger than a cat. Besides, they're just plants. What's the worst they could do?

761700103.text: I remember a certain fresh-faced adventurer saying something similar, right before coming face-to-face with a Hexadecatonic Mandragora...

761700107.text: Wha— What're you all hollering about, huh? Paimon heard the commotion from miles away! Is this some sort of class?

761700108.text: Yep, it sure is! Linnea's telling us all about her recent findings.

761700109.text: That sounds fun. Can we sit in?

761700110.text: Of course! Please take a seat.

761700111.text: Since we're on the subject of Hexadecatonic Mandragoras, there's another notable variety of plant that can be found near Voidsea Outlook...

761700113.text: Spot on! I'm talking about Winter Icelea.

761700114.text: Hey, Jurva, that's cheating! Linnea didn't even finish asking!

761700115.text: Ah, sorry... I got carried away and jumped the gun. Don't worry, there'll be plenty more questions to answer, right, Linnea?

761700116.text: Enough for everyone! Get your answers at the ready, and you'll all have the chance to earn yourselves a sugar sculpture!

761700117.text: #Ooh, a sweet, sweet, sugary reward! Come on, {NICKNAME}, this is our time to shine!

761700122.text: Right! Back to the topic at hand... There's actually an interesting story about Winter Icelea.

761700123.text: Legend has it that this plant held a deep connection to the "King of Winter Icelea." Now, the "King of Winter Icelea" had a brother, whose own symbolic plant is something you should all be very familiar with... Can anyone tell me what it is?

761700120.text: Don't worry, I'll let you in on a secret — Katya's prepared enough sugar sculptures for everyone.

761700121.text: Oh! In that case, we'll have to show them just how smart we are!

761700301.text: There's another legend that claims the opposing colors of the Nocturnal Blossom represent two sisters from the Frostmoon Scions...

761700302.text: Do they kill each other, too? I noticed that lots of stories have siblings who end up killing each other. What's up with that? We're not like that in the Conch Gang.

761700303.text: Hey, let Linnea finish the story, will you? I bet the sisters make up in the end, right?

761700304.text: Otherwise, why would people use the Nocturnal Blossom with its two flowers joined together to represent them? ...I hope they make up in the end.

761700401.text: Linnea's always dashing off to here, there, and everywhere, but she still makes time to share her knowledge with us... I've learned a lot from her, and I'm grateful for that.
